instructions: SIMPLIFIED STAGE 1 — Call load_ta_core_graph, then load_scene_condition_graph, then load_domain_gap_candidates exactly once for each of the six domains. The program handles relevance filtering and paging. Do not create a discovery ledger. Begin registration after all six domains load. THIS TEST MUST STOP IMMEDIATELY AFTER Stage 2 is sealed; no Stage 3 call is permitted.

tools.name: begin_requirement_registration
tools.description: End manual discovery and begin registering the retained requirements.

tools.name: load_domain_gap_candidates
tools.description: Simplified Stage 1C: in one call, return the configured retriever's bounded graph-gap candidates for one inspection domain; no model-controlled pagination.

tools.name: load_scene_condition_graph
tools.description: Stage 1B deterministic graph query: activate component requirement families from true scene facts, accepted component classes, and TA-core required-device implications.

tools.name: load_ta_core_graph
tools.description: Stage 1A deterministic graph query: load the selected Typical Application's components, explicit references, governing source units, and reachable normative candidates.
